elements.name: CYCLE
elements.gloss: a body that comes round again. Never closed — a closed cycle is apparatus, not an animal.

elements.name: TRACE
elements.gloss: a line gathering over itself. Exists only as an accumulation; no single frame holds it.

elements.name: SWEEP
elements.gloss: a wavefront crossing a field, left to right.

elements.name: TRANSFER
elements.gloss: material moving from one surface to another. It brightens at the midpoint; nothing dims.

elements.name: ADVANCE
elements.gloss: discrete steps with a dwell. Stepping, not sliding.

elements.name: DISSOLVE
elements.gloss: an ordered per-dot swap. This world has no alpha, so a dissolve is an allegiance change.

elements.name: HOLD
elements.gloss: not a freeze. A breath under 1% of frame — you should not be able to say for certain it moved.

elements.name: BREAK
elements.gloss: the one permitted discontinuity, declared in the module that uses it.

elements.name: SPEAK
elements.gloss: the ninth motion. A sentence runs once and stops; if it came round again it would not be a sentence.

elements.name: LISTEN
elements.gloss: the tenth, and the quietest. A face responding to a voice it is not making.
